name: Dressellian
description: Dressellians were a species of sentient humanoids that were native to Dressel. They lived in peaceful isolation from any conflict until the Galactic Civil War. As a species, they were loyal to the Galactic Republic and after its demise many Dressellians joined the Rebel Alliance. They had hairless heads and wrinkled visages and cranium. Orrimaarko, a male Dressellian, was a soldier for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
